Підрядні часу: when, as soon as, until +: Time clauses: when, as soon as, until + present tense
Після when, as soon as, after, before, u: After when, as soon as, after, before, until, if and unless we talk about the future in the present tense: I’ll call you when I get home. Will stays only in the main part of the sentence. We also look at the difference between when and if.
when, after, before + теперішній час про: when, after, before + present tense about the future
I’ll call you when I get home.
as soon as: щойно, одразу як: as soon as: right when, immediately after
As soon as the rain stops, we’ll go out.
until (till): доки не, аж до: until (till): up to the moment when
Wait here until I come back.
if і unless: умова (unless = if not): if and unless: a condition (unless = if not)
We won’t go unless it stops raining.
have / has + V3, коли важливо, що дія вж: have / has + V3, when it matters that the action will be finished
I’ll give you the book when I’ve finished it.
головна частина: will / can / наказ + V;: main part: will / can / an order + V; time clause: when / as soon as / after / before / until / if + Present Simple
заперечення в підрядній: don’t / doesn’t: negative in the time clause: don’t / doesn’t + V; in the main part: won’t + V
питання ставимо в головній частині, підр: the question goes in the main part, the time clause stays normal
якщо підрядна стоїть першою, після неї к: if the time clause comes first, put a comma after it; if it comes second, no comma is needed
when / after / as soon as + have / has +: when / after / as soon as + have / has + V3: we stress that the action will be finished
